newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 17.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

FRATERNITE MATIN - Five-day regional seminar starts in Abidjan on results of the Uruguay round of world trade negotiations; seminar jointly organised by the secretariat of the African, Caribbean and Pacific trade group, the European Union and the World Trade Organisation. - More than 300 foreign firms and 400 local companies have announced their participation in November 7-17 Ivory Coast's Expo-CI 96 trade fair, says chamber of commerce and industry.

LA VOIE - Health ministry declares war against street vendors of unauthorised medicines. - Despite official assurances, personnel of Ivorian phone monopoly CI-TELCOM still worried about their future after planned privatisation of their company later this year.

LE JOUR - Privatisation of Palm-Indutsrie runs into difficulties. The government has been forced to cancel two tenders for sale of state-owned palm blocks because of lack of offers. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
